dimensions.description: Required workspace files exist and supplied source samples still match the generated SHA-256 manifest.
All generated task checklist items are marked complete.
Scope/date/device and distinct result, verification and limitations contain substantive evidence.
Observations, assumptions, commands/results and limitations are substantive and not duplicated boilerplate.
Awarded only on labs with a lab-specific automatic validator that checks expected artifacts/results.

credential_note: Review-mode labs receive a documentation-readiness result and require explicit reviewer/self-review acknowledgment. Only the final assessment set uses lab-specific automatic technical validators. The completion record remains self-managed and non-accredited.
